Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

Warm time after each run and keep-warm GPUs are billed; open workspace sessions that are not closed properly (or use Auto Expand Session) keep billing GPU time. Workflow timeout can be raised up to 24 h on request.

fleet.notes: Pay-as-you-go: GPU concurrency 1 and max 3 cloud machines. Per-machine Max Parallel GPU goes up to 10, and more needs an email to founders@comfydeploy.com. Closed to new customers.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

secret_proxy.note: Machine 'Secrets' tab -> secret groups (e.g. API_KEY_COMFY_ORG) injected as environment variables into the machine container. Docs: 'Click create and you will be prompted to rebuild the machine.' The real key is inside the container. No proxy.

volume_attach.quote: Comfy Deploy gives you your own private volume that holds your models. It gets connected to `comfyui/models` so you can populate your own models directories with the models you want from anywhere.
volume_attach.note: One per-account/org model volume (a Modal Volume) mounted automatically at /private_models, plus a platform-wide public model volume mounted read-only. You cannot create or attach arbitrary extra volumes. Custom S3 for inputs/outputs is Business-only via support.

volume_shared.note: The same private model volume is in the `volumes` mapping of every runner container of every machine (max_containers = concurrency limit), so parallel GPUs read it at once. The private volume is read-write (runner commits to it); the shared public model volume is mounted read-only (`public_model_volume.read_only()`). Docs intro: 'letting your team share the same custom nodes environments, models and workflows'.

usage_api.quote: Platform is closed to new customers as of 2026-09-29. API documentation exists but no per-sandbox usage/billing endpoint is documented. Credit-based pay-as-you-go billing tracked through account dashboard only.
usage_api.note: granularity: account-only; cost: no; Service is live for existing customers only. API reference exists but does not expose per-sandbox usage metrics or billing data. Only account-level credit balance tracking mentioned in available documentation.

locations_quote: Comfy Deploy is closed to new customers. The service remains online and supported for existing customers only. No customer-facing region selection or documentation of specific locations is provided.
